## Sila change purpose

Explain the actual Sila change and the reason it is needed. Do not claim that
unverified network functionality, approvals, or previous discussions exist.

## Affected Sila components

State which native Sila specifications, tests, or build components are changed.
Identify any unresolved Sila-owned implementation or normative dependency.

## Verification

Record the tests that actually ran and explain remaining technical blockers.

## Review scope

The Sila review gate identifies required roles from the changed files.
Only explicitly authorized GitHub reviewers can meet those requirements.
A review or CI check never activates a protocol upgrade or creates an approval.

## Publication

This pull request does not authorize automatic public publication or merging.
